data.title: 信浓 · 罗帐深宵的幽梦凝睇
data.description: 幽深的紫藤纱幔低垂，层叠的真丝被褥之上，信浓宛如梦境神姬般侧卧。九条雪白的狐尾如同最柔软的屏障将外界隔绝，营造出专属于两人的静谧空间。金色眸子倒映着微弱烛火，唇边扬起恬淡安然的微笑，仿佛在邀请心上人一同沉入永不褪色的美梦。
data.location: intimate traditional bedchamber with gossamer silk canopy
data.action: lying gracefully on silk bed enclosed by sheer canopies and nine fox tails, sheer nightwear, holding pillow gently, golden eyes gleaming in candlelight, serene affectionate gaze
data.lighting: soft candlelight glowing through lavender silk canopy curtains
data.mood: transcendent poetic romance, sacred private sanctuary
data.promptProse: Lying upon a silk bed enclosed by sheer curtains and her nine fluffy white tails, Shinano looks up in warm candlelight. Her translucent robe cascades over delicate shoulders as she gazes with divine, tender affection.
data.animaCaption: Shinano lying inside a canopy bed sheltered by her nine fox tails under soft candle glow.
